As per the contents of the FIR, it has been alleged as under :-
"To, The Senior Superintendent of Police, Police District, Khanna.

Sub: Application for taking necessary action against (1) Keshav Mittal son of Deepak Mittal resident of H.No. C- 3, Acharaya Kirplani Road, Near PNB ATM Adarsh Nagar, New Sabzi Mandi Model Town, North West, West Delhi, PIN-110033.

M.No. 99712- 03669, (2)
Mamtesh Kumar (Nathu Rana) son of Moti Ram, M.No. 90508-31000 (3) Vijender Singh son of Moti Ram both residents of VPO Brass, District Karnal, PIN-132024, (4)
Ajit Dubey Employee M.No. 88515-00414 (5) Dinesh Employee.
Respected Sir, it is respectfully submits as under: 1, That the applicants are law abiding and peace loving bonafide citizen and residents of Khanna.
2. That applicants are partners of M/s Gujjar Mal Harbans Lal, Shop No. 79, New Grain Market, Khanna and running the business of merchant and commission agent of Foodgrains.

3. That the above CRM-M No.13232 of 2024 (O&M) ::2:: 2024:PHHC:051488 stated accused No. 1, 4 Keshav Mittal vs State Of Punjab on 16 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/179976777/
1 and 5 visited the shop of the applicant in the month of September, 2022 for purchase of paddy basmati.

sentences.text: Accused No. 1 represented himself as partner/owner of R.N. Rice Unit Miller and Exporter and accused No. 4 and 5 represented themselves as an employee of the unit.
That it was also represented that accused No. 2 and 3 are partner/owner of the R.N. Rice Unit.
4. That above stated accused demanded paddy basmati on credit basis and applicant supplied 3165.75 Qtl. of paddy and 9045 empty bags to the above stated accused persons on different dates.

5. That applicants supplied 3165.75 Qtls. of paddy and 9045 empty bags to the accused persons totaling amount Rs. 1,17,40,860.39 Ps. which relates to Kacha Arhtiya and farmers as complainant business in on commission basis.

6. That applicants also supplied bills to the accused persons and also supplied G.R./Bilty to the accused persons along with Q Forms and accused persons received the entire goods supplied by the applicants on different dates.

7. That from the very beginning accused persons intentionally delayed the payment and after many representations accused persons made payment of Rs.5,416/- (TDS on commission) on 01.10.2022, Rs. 5,00,000/- on 09.11.2022, Rs.
5,00,000/- on 14.11.2022, Rs. 3,00,000/- on 14.12.2022, Rs. 4,00,000/- on 19.12.2022, Rs. 3,00,000/- on 27.12.2022 and Rs. 10,00,000/- on 07.01.0222 vide cheque No.000225 drawn at HDFC Bank Ltd. Branch Taraori (Haryana) dated 12.12.2022 which was passed on 07.01.2022 on persistent requests and demands.

8. 
That now there is Rs.87,35,444.39 Ps. are still pending against the accused persons.
9. That now the applicants came to know that accused person are playing hide and seek with the applicants from the very beginning.

That at the time of supply of goods,
the accused No. 2 and 3 were only partners of R.N. Rice Unit Miller and Exporter and Keshav Mittal accused No. 1 falsely represented himself as partner/owner of the firm with intention to play fraud with the applicants.

10. That accused No. 2 Mamtesh Kumar was active partner of the firm, who carried/ooking after the business of R.N Rice Unit and now he has left the partnership on the day goods were started supplying to accused and till today Mamtesh Kumar is looking after the entire business without being partner and with malafide intention to withheld the balance amount of CRM-M No.13232 of 2024 (O&M) ::3:: 2024:PHHC:051488 applicants.

11. 
That all the above stated accused with intention to cause wrongful loss to the applicant and for wrongful gain to themselves in a criminal conspiracy with intention to forfeit Rs.87,35,444.39 Ps. of the applicants.

12. That all the accused with common intention in a criminal conspiracy played fraud with the applicants to withheld the balance amount and wrongfully and illegally refused to make the remaining payment Rs.87,35,444.39 Ps. to the applicants.

13. That the accused persons posed threats to the applicant with dire consequences in case applicant file any complaint with the police authorities or any other department and accused persons further threatened that they are having links with high-up and politically strong and threatened that police authority cannot do act against them.
14. That the applicants have attached copies of bills, GRs, Q Forms and statement of account along with this application.
It is therefore prayed that strict action be taken against the above mentioned accused persons and life and limb of the applicant be protected, in the interest of justice.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that it is purely a civil dispute which has been given criminal colour and thus no offence is made out and the petitioner will be entitled for grant of pre-arrest bail.
I have heard learned counsel for the petitioner and have gone through the records of the case.

The allegation against the petitioner is not mere breach of contract but the allegation is that the petitioner misrepresented himself to be partner/owner of R.N. Rice Unit Miller and Exporter and thus it cannot be said that it is mere breach of the contract or merely a civil dispute.

CRM-M No.13232 of 2024 (O&M) ::4:: 2024:PHHC:051488 6 AS per settled law laid down by Apex Court in Gurbaksh Singh Sibbia vs. State of Punjab, 1980 (2) SCC 565, reiterated in Sushila Aggarwal and others Vs. State (NCT of Dethi) and another, 2020 (5) SCC f the Court while considering prayer for pre-arrest bail has to consider as to whether the accusation appears to be actuated by mala fides, nature of seriousness of the proposed charges, the role attributed to the applicant and the probabilities of securing presence of the applicant during the course of trial and as to whether there is any apprehension that the applicant will tamper with the witnesses or evidence.
